The Anti-Deficiency Act (ADA), codified primarily at 31 U.S.C. §§ 1341–1342 and 1511–1519, is a U.S. federal law that prohibits executive branch agencies from spending or obligating federal funds in excess of the amounts appropriated by Congress, or before appropriations are made available.
